summary: Frontend-only retest of SIPRO BI (/bi) enriched MetricDetailDialog fixes. Logged in as superadmin, verified LED-01 (horizontal bar breakdown of 8 sources, Kontribusi column, Total 37 / 100%), USR-01 (composition donut of 6 categories with Kontribusi + Total 38 — NOT a series chart), SLS-01 (dual charts: series area + category bars; NO Kontribusi column, NO Total row, description 'Tiap kategori berdiri sendiri — satuannya tidak bisa dijumlahkan.'), SLS-06 regression (donut center compact 'Rp 382,5 jt', Kontribusi 55,6% / 44,4%, Total Rp 382.500.000 / 100%), and formula rendering (no duplicated Σ on cards or dialog hero; only legitimate mid-formula Σ remains, e.g. PRJ-01 'bobot langkah terverifikasi / Σ bobot'). Smoke: 3 metrics x 5 hubs (eksekutif, penjualan, marketing, proyek, tim) = 15 dialogs opened, all closed via Escape (X button verified on USR-01), 0 console errors / 0 page errors. All 6 requested items PASS.

design_issues.screen: SLS-01 detail dialog — 'Pecahan per kategori' bars
issues: All 3 breakdown rows share the identical label 'Tipe 45/90', so the horizontal bars/table rows are indistinguishable from one another (data/labeling, not chart logic). Consider disambiguating with unit code / cluster / block in the breakdown label.

action_items: Optional (LOW): make SLS-01 breakdown labels unique (currently 3x 'Tipe 45/90').
critical_code_review_comments: MetricDetailDialog kind={rows.length <= 6 && showShare ? 'pie' : 'bar'} verified: never 'auto', so the breakdown panel can no longer render series data. unitMismatch guard correctly gates showShare/showTotal for SLS-01 (value=3 units vs Rp breakdown). No defects found in the 4 fix files.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BI tabs are: eksekutif, penjualan, marketing, proyek, tim, kamus (data-testid='tab-page-tab-<key>'); there is no 'keuangan' tab. Dialogs open via [data-detail='<CODE>'], dialog root [data-testid='bi-metric-detail'], rows [data-testid='bi-metric-detail-row'], charts [data-testid='bi-chart']. Table headers render uppercase via CSS but inner_text returns 'KONTRIBUSI' — compare case-insensitively. Chart type detection: .recharts-bar-rectangle / .recharts-area / .recharts-pie-sector. Note: kind='bar' with <=6 rows and additive units renders a DONUT (pie) by design — that is expected, not a series-chart regression. Environment restarted once mid-run (transient Cloudflare 502); retry after supervisorctl status shows RUNNING.
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration_107's defect (breakdown panel drawing series data for LED-01/USR-01) is resolved: MetricChart now receives an explicit 'pie'/'bar' kind, so isSeries is false for the breakdown panel and rows come from metric.breakdown. Verified visually: LED-01 renders 8 horizontal bars, USR-01 a 6-slice donut.
